description: `-o --coverage` with `collectCoverageFrom: ['src/**/*.ts']` (CoverageReporter.ts L193-L199 hands `changedFiles` and `sourcesRelatedToTestsInChangedFiles` to the untested-file worker, which asks `shouldInstrument`): of the files no test loads, `src/untested-changed.ts` is changed and is reported with zero counters, while `src/untested.ts` and `src/other.ts` are left out. Jest only. Read by `provino`'s `jest-coverage-changed.test.ts`.
